_about: Cyclopentyl methyl ether (1) + Ethanol (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 94.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclopentyl methyl ether, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: A. Mejia, M. Cartes, Experimental Determination of Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium and Isothermal Interfacial Tensions for the Binary Ethanol + Cyclopentyl Methyl Ether Mixture, J. Chem. Eng. Data 64 (2019) 1970-1977
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 11. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.13 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
